app/react-router.config.ts:4 — only ssr: true (itself the default); no future flags, no unstable_api-only
app/app/root.tsx:5-14 — Layout/Links/Meta/Scripts/ScrollRestoration/isRouteErrorResponse, all stable since v7.0; view-transition APIs deprecated in 8.5.0 are avoided
app/app/lib/api.server.ts:40 — data(null, {status: 404}), stable since 7.9.0 (Sept 2025) and the documented json() replacement
app/app/routes/home.tsx:3,92-93 — Route.* typegen types and useSearchParams/useNavigate, long-stable
reach.rationale: The app is built entirely on long-stable framework APIs; the newest thing it touches (data()) has been stable for over a year and is the officially recommended idiom.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:39-41 — the single data() call is wrapped in one notFound() helper used by all routes
app/app/routes/not-found.tsx:1-8 — reuses the same helper rather than duplicating the pattern
containment.rationale: There are no experimental APIs to contain; the one mildly-new API (data()) is isolated behind a single helper in one module.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:40 — data() with status 404 matches the official skill guidance for missing records (references/framework-mode.md:136)
app/vite.config.ts:1-8 — plain reactRouter() plugin plus Vite 8's stable resolve.tsconfigPaths; no beta/canary toolchain
justification.rationale: Nothing experimental is used, so nothing is unjustified; each API chosen is the current documented best practice rather than an older deprecated equivalent (e.g. data() over the removed json()).

findings.issue: ssr: true is explicitly set although it is the framework default, leaving the config file with no effective content
findings.suggestion: Either remove the option or keep it as deliberate documentation; consider deleting the config file entirely if no non-default options are ever needed

summary: This is an extremely conservative, zero-experimental-usage app: every import (Link, Form, NavLink, Outlet, useNavigate/useSearchParams, Meta/Links/Scripts, ScrollRestoration, isRouteErrorResponse, typegen Route types) has been stable since v7.0-7.9, well over a year before today. The only non-ancient API, data(), is the officially documented replacement for json() and is isolated behind one notFound() helper. None of React Router 8.5's unstable offerings (API-only mode, unstable_fetch, custom route discovery, RSC, Await unstable_promise) are touched.
